move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

Your earlier messages link additional capacity to binding commitment—it sounds like dependable demand is essential to making room in your allocation. We are ready to commit long-term if you can secure our full requirement, supporting predictable planning for both sides. How can we turn that commitment into a dependable capacity reservation?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10). Producer prices DE: other rubber products changed -0.3% from 2026-01 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-C2219@2026-01, idx:PPI-C2219@2026-02). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You confirm the allocation against our long-term proposal and repeat the lead time—it sounds like planning certainty is central to making this work. We want to support that certainty while securing dependable coverage of our full requirement. How can we translate that commitment into a price that supports a sustainable agreement for both of us?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.11 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We verified the labour cost index data you cited and adjusted our calculation accordingly. We confirm the terms of 23,400 units per year for 36 months with a 56-day lead time. Based on these parameters, we can offer a revised price of EUR 31.30 per unit. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. For this Angebot, we present a price of €31.30 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
